name: Pakistan Origin Card (POC)

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant is a foreign national with annulled Pakistani nationality, was born to parents who previously held Pakistani nationality, or is a family member of such a person.

evidence_required.document: Proof of applicant's or parent's former Pakistani nationality

outcome.duration_length: indefinite (card itself is periodically renewed/reissued; underlying entitlement does not expire)

sources.title: Pakistan High Commission, London (official mission page) -- POC eligibility: foreigners with annulled Pakistani nationality, persons born to parents who previously held Pakistani nationality, and family members of eligible persons; applications must be submitted online only, manual booking and walk-in discontinued

FAFEN (Free and Fair Election Network, NGO) -- comparison of NIC/NICOP/POC: POC holders get visa-free entry to Pakistan, property purchase/sale rights (with conditions), bank account access, and extended stays, but cannot vote and do not enjoy full constitutional rights of citizens

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Pakistan). Hard requirement sourced tier-1 (Pakistan High Commission London). The specific rights bundle (visa-free entry, property rights, banking, no voting) is corroborated only by an NGO explainer (tier 4, fafen.org) -- not modeled as a hard requirement, just used for the outcome/notes description, consistent with this dataset's convention of only requiring tier-1 sourcing for HARD requirements. work_rights set to 'restricted' pending confirmation of the exact employment-rights scope; study_rights set to 'full' per the property/residency-parity generally described for POC holders. This is functionally Pakistan's diaspora/ancestry route, distinct from NICOP (which is for people who ARE STILL Pakistani citizens living abroad, not modeled as a separate file here since it does not itself grant or change immigration status -- it is an identity document for existing citizens).
